Thanks for playing GESTALT so far, and to the players for making these issues known!

notes.title: Public Walkthrough Now Available!
notes.content:
《GESTALT: The Fifth Day》Ending II Walkthrough Now Available!

Hey y'all!

Smaller update, but I wanted to let everyone know that a public guide for Ending II has been made available in the Guide section of the GESTALT: The Fifth Day's Steam page. This guide was originally included in the game files as a txt. document, but now that more people are playing the game, and with the new content that's been added and updated, I wanted to release a newer, cleaner, more cohesive guide for new players.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44740738/b978459dd459869b4156872d816115b8ca8448b6.png

The guide is meant to help players get Ending II, which also unlocks the Another Day post-game story for those of you who now have the DLC. This means that every scenario's solution is there, spoiler-free for those who need help or get stuck on a particular part of the game. Because this walkthrough is only for Ending II, the guide doesn't cover how to get Endings III, IV, and V, nor does it tell you how to access special secrets or the secret codes, and does not include a guide for the Another Day post-game story. For all of that, I'll leave that up to you guys!

As the guide states, if you're new to GESTALT, I recommend playing through the game at least once without a guide. Most other players will know why, but its best to go in blind first if you can. However, if you are really stuck or don't really wanna do that, the guide is still there and available to the public. 

Have fun!

- K I N J A

notes.title: HALLOWEEN UPDATE + ANOTHER DAY DLC PATCH NOTES!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44740738/b6f3b44f3c63483ec603354b037a5a67118fc94d.png
《GESTALT: The Fifth Day》Halloween Update + Another Day DLC Patch Notes!

Hey y'all!

The game's biggest update is here, along with a DLC. This means a lot of changes have been added to the game, which we can go over now. PLEASE NOTE: These changes only apply to the EN translation of the game! This update and the DLC have not been localized, so for international players, you will not have these changes just yet. Otherwise, here are the notes!

PATCH NOTES

HALLOWEEN UPDATE

 Achievement data has been reworked to better sync achievements between the game and Steam's backend. The internal achievement screen can be used by player to report any differences between what their own achievement progress says in comparison to their progress on Steam. There will be an internal system that will sync the player's current achievement progress with this new system in order to ensure that no current achievement progress is lost during the update.
 The "Mein Gott!" achievement has been added to the game.
 The use of persistent data to track playthroughs has reworked. Some players beat the game on an outdated framework that caused an error upon beating the game only in select playthroughs, while those with Update 2 seem to not have this issue. This new framework is the basis for this update, and the game will update automatically in order to prevent this issue in the future.
 The UI and functionality of the laptop has changed in order to better integrate it into the game itself, and make searches easier.
 Rollback has been removed across select areas of the game in order to allow players to undo certain choices if they wish (scenarios affected: EMMA, RADIO, and ETERNITY).
 Scares have been made unskippable across the game (have fun!). This was made to prevent instances where players would click text too fast, miss it, and become confused.
 Super Emma Mode can now be accessed during Days 2, 3, and 4.
 A small handful of new search terms have been added to the laptop.
 The cylinder lock used in ETERNITY has been changed and updated, but still provides the same results. This was to ease confusion around working the lock itself upon being found, and now is much easier to use.
 An asset in the bedroom during Day 1 will now have a chance to change
 An asset in the kitchen during Day 1 has been changed in order to better reflect the BUTCHER scenario from the DLC.
 An asset has been added to the prologue of the DRAIN scenario.
 Two assets have had their positions corrected and adjusted during the EMMA scenario.
 New, small lines of dialogue have been added/altered during the ETERNITY scenario.
 One of the two base game secret codes has been moved to the DLC. This decision was made because what that code unlocks is incredibly useful for long-term play and achievement hunting, and needs to be made easier to find for players who wish to explore more of the game. Though it's been relegated to the DLC, it is much easier to find now. Additionally, for anyone who found this code previously, it is still available in the base game without the DLC, and can still be activated without the DLC as well.

ANOTHER DAY DLC

 3 new scenarios have been added to Days 2, 3, and 4 (BUTCHER, GNOMES, and DUNGEON respectively).
 A new post-game scenario has been added to the game. This scenario unlocks after you have obtained Ending II, and if you have already gotten Ending II, the scenario already be unlocked for you. You can play this scenario by accessing it from the game's main menu in the bottom-right corner.
 7 new achievements are added to the game: Bury a Friend, Seconds, Dungeon Master, A Life Worth Living, Such a Miserable Life, Secret Master, and Another Day.
 2 new secret codes have been added to the game.
 1 base-game secret code has been moved to the DLC (read within the "Halloween Update" section above for more information).
 A few new search terms are added to the laptop.
 Secret dialogue and conversations have been added to the game.
 New hints are given at the end of BUTCHER, GNOMES, and DUNGEON's good endings.
 Dialogue in Day 5 will change if you have gotten one of the bad endings to the GNOMES scenario. Dialogue has also been added to the end of the game if you are about to get Ending II and have gotten the good endings to BUTCHER, GNOMES, and/or BUTCHER.
 An area of the house will be slightly different in Day 4 if you have gotten the good ending to the GNOMES	scenario.
 


Thanks again to everyone playing! The game will continue to receive updates if more issues occur, so keep posting in the discussion threads if you see anything, and I'll be on top of it. Happy Halloween! 🎃✨

- K I N J A

notes.title: ANOTHER DAY (DLC Announcement!)
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=w0p0q9m6SCo;full][/previewyoutube]
《GESTALT: The Fifth Day》Another Day DLC Announcement!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44740738/51b0e0ea23fad2a75f21f16b6fec6f926a74e3e5.png

Hey y'all!

It's been about half a year now since the release of GESTALT: The Fifth Day, and between all of the YouTube videos, Twitch streams, and online whispers, I really couldn't be happier with it's reception so far. Now, I can finally announce that GESTALT is getting some DLC, aptly called the 'Another Day' DLC! This DLC is releasing at the very start of Steam Scream Fest, on October 28, 2024 (less than a month from now) available to download for $3!

This will be the first and last DLC for the game, and I made sure to make it count with a lot of new content. The Another Day DLC will include the following:


 3 New scenarios added to Days 2, 3, and 4. These scenarios are titled, "BUTCHER," "GNOMES," and "DUNGEON."
 A post-game story called "Another Day," which unlocks and takes place after Ending II. This plays similarly to the scenarios in the main game, although it is about twice as long. The story follows Wicke trying to figure out how to appease a creature called the 'Ogre' that has appeared in the house, while also trying to uncover the secrets of the home's mysterious previous owner, Agatha "Old Aggie" MacDonald.
 8 New Achievements, plus a completely overhauled achievement system. This is meant to play much nicer with Steam's framework, and prevent achievements from disappearing on Steam. There will also be a new achievement tracker in the Options menu, where you can track your achievements in-game as well!
 2 New secret codes.
 New secrets added throughout the game.
 Updates and changes to certain gameplay mechanics to make the game more intuitive.
 And more!


Along with the DLC, the game will also be receiving a major update (Update #3), which will include the new achievement system/tracker, one of the new secret codes, many of the updated mechanics/polishing used in the DLC. There will be more information to come closer to when the DLC and Update #3 both drop, so hang tight and stay tuned. Happy October!

- K I N J A

notes.title: UPDATE #2 (Live Now + Patch Notes!)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44740738/e0330d32119b75afd20b93f329875b532290b87e.png
《GESTALT: The Fifth Day》Update #2 Is LIVE!

Hey y'all!

Update #2 is finally here, and we've got some major problems patched up with this one! I'm so glad I could address some of the problems affecting some of you, and and that anyone new to the game can enjoy the cleanest version of it so far. Here's the patch notes that come with this update:

PATCH NOTES:

 An error screen would occur for some players upon completing the game for the first time. This was an issue with persistence data, and luckily this error will no longer occur. (All versions)
 Achievements should no longer disappear from Steam! (All versions)
 Some audio has been edited in the TRAINING scenario. (All versions)
 It was previously possible to infinitely create plant food in the PLANTS scenario, which is no longer possible. (All versions)
 A set of visuals have been altered in the ETERNITY scenario, as the previous visuals conveyed unclear information to some players and caused some confusion. (All versions)
 A visual has been slightly altered in the TRAINING scenario. (EN version only)
 Minor spelling errors have been corrected in the EMMA scenario and SUPER EMMA MODE. (EN version only)
 The prompt to delete achievements and/or persistence data that appears when selecting 'Clear All' under Achievements (in the Options page when pausing) has been added to all international versions of the game. (Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese versions)
 The timer in the ETERNITY scenario has been translated from English. (Japanese version only)
 A line of English dialogue in the MOTHER scenario has been translated. (Japanese version only)
 Some minor changes to dialogue text speed has been altered in the EMMA scenario to fit the pace of the other versions of the game. (Traditional Chinese version only)
 One of the input options for the laptop in the living room has been slightly altered. (Traditional Chinese version only)
 The 'Clear All' text under Achievements in the Options tab has been translated from English. (Simplified Chinese only)


Thanks again to those of you who post playthroughs, stream the game, or chat in the Discussion forums. It's been super fun to watch people come across more and more hidden features and secrets of the game, and has also been an amazing tool to look for errors or ways to improve the game in real time. I hope with this update, you've got the best version of the game so, and as usual never be shy to reach out of post feedback. Enjoy the update!

- K I N J A

notes.title: UPDATE #1 is LIVE!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44740738/0c1e6bedd31e907515a22fcace4402f18bb01485.png
《GESTALT: The Fifth Day》Update #1 Is LIVE!

Hey y'all!

It's been a week now since GESTALT: The Fifth Day's launch, and I'd like to say thanks again to everyone playing so far! Now that the game is available to everyone, it's time for the set of updates and fixes, which are live right now. If you update GESTALT: The Fifth Day on your Steam client, the changes will be applied, and you'll be set to play from there! Thank you to the content creators and those of you in the game's discussion boards for pointing out any issues you found during play, these comments really helped with creating this update. Below are the patch notes for the changes that have been made to the game for Update #1:

PATCH NOTES:

 Spelling typos have been corrected throughout the game (English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese versions).
 The "s" and "a" keys have been properly disabled on all screens of the game in some versions, as previously pressing them during play would cause a game-ending error (Simplified and Traditional Chinese versions).
 The background used after completing all of Emma's conversations in the EMMA scenario has been corrected. Previously, You would always get sent back to the living room upon completing these conversations, and now you are sent back to whatever room you were already in (All versions). 
 The background used after failing the EMMA scenario in the basement has been corrected. Previously, an outdated version of this background was being used (All versions).
 The two secret code locations have been swapped for thematic reasons (All versions).
 One of the two secret codes has been changed. One of the codes in the game used an old code that no longer works in this version of the game, and has now been corrected to the proper code. This also means that Ending V is now obtainable in legitimate playthroughs (All versions). 
 A missing path to achieve Ending III has been fixed and updated. This affects certain playthroughs of The Fourth Day (All versions). 
 The music that plays when the [???] visits you after obtaining a good end to any scenario has been changed. The previous music used was a free-use cover of the Great Fairy theme by MattriOST on YouTube. After feedback from player concerns about copyright warnings during streams and video content, the music that plays is now an original track compiled by KINJA (All versions).
 Persistent data affecting Ending II has been fixed and updated. This issue previously affected players seeking the "My Name is Wicke" achievement, as the game would not register that you have completed Ending II. With this corrected, players who obtain all endings after this update should now receive the "My Name is Wicke" achievement (All versions).


As a note, my team and I have seen an issue regarding certain player's achievements disappearing from Steam. While working on this update we have not found a reason for why this may be happening, and are in the process of talking with Valve about the issue. We want to resolve this issue as soon as we can, and will be addressing this problem in the game's next update. Until then, we hope the changes made improve your playthrough experience and open up some new secrets for you to find!

- K I N J A

notes.content:
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43921064/11084f25b0e6094e39a73ecdd09eaee85a50c1a0.png

Invoke your deepest fear. Can you make it through these five days?

Add to Wishlist NOW!!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2616720/_/

Wickeina 'Wicke' Gestalt lives in a haunted house.

It can be difficult to find happiness when toiling away at your full time job. Combine that with a house full of entities and strange phenomenon that all seem to work against her, and it's clear that Wicke is stuck in a difficult circumstance. Inheriting the house from a dead, old woman that she hardly even knew, Wicke has lived in the house for some time now, trying to strike a balance between the hours toiled away by her job, and the strange horrors of the house. She is at her wit's end. She cannot keep living a life without control. During these five days within the house, what may be an ordinary week of lost autonomy and horror may just be her last chance to regain control of her life and overcome the decline of her mental state.

All will be decided on the inevitable fifth day. 

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43921064/e438f8e00f5d8419f8deec5da1d7ad2f98b7580f.gif

 A point-and-click style of navigation and exploration
 Puzzles, problem-solving, and drag/drop sequences to solve problems and mysteries
 Ever-changing scenarios and story based on Wicke's choices that bare consequences with each mistake
 Multiple endings based on Wicke's actions
 Psychological horror based around dread, depression, and the unknown
 A story-driven narrative
 A short game meant to be finished within 2-3 hours (Appx. 29k words)

Store page new released!《GESTALT: The Fifth Day》
Prequel Synopsis Manga Released:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44740738/98df44dbc140c7260750c819b327048a42f9211c.png
STORY:

Wickeina 'Wicke' Gestalt lives in a haunted house.

It can be difficult to find happiness when toiling away at your full time job. Combine that with a house full of entities and strange phenomenon that all seem to work against her, and it's clear that Wicke is stuck in a difficult circumstance. Inheriting the house from a dead, old woman that she hardly even knew, Wicke has lived in the house for some time now, trying to strike a balance between the hours toiled away by her job, and the strange horrors of the house. She is at her wit's end. The cannot keep living a life without control. During these five days within the house, what may be an ordinary week of lost autonomy and horror may just be her last chance to regain control of her life and overcome the decline of her mental state.

All will be decided on the inevitable fifth day.
